stories.title: Brain Loop Lock Schema with TTL, Owner Heartbeat, and State Transitions
stories.description: Define lock model including lock_id, owner_id, acquired_at, ttl_seconds, last_heartbeat_at, and explicit state transitions (active, expired, recovering) tailored to Brain loop execution semantics.

stories.title: Heartbeat-Aware TTL Evaluation Engine
stories.description: Implement TTL evaluation that considers both acquired_at and last_heartbeat_at to distinguish active long-running executions from truly stale locks.

stories.title: Deadlock Classification and Safe Recovery Strategy
stories.description: Implement classification of lock states (expired, abandoned, conflicting owner) and execute recovery strategies including safe release, backoff, and controlled reacquisition.

stories.title: Brain Runner Integration with Lock Heartbeat and Recovery Hooks
stories.description: Integrate lock acquisition, periodic heartbeat updates, TTL checks, and recovery hooks into brain_runner execution cycles to ensure continuous progress without manual intervention.

stories.title: Failure Injection and Concurrency Stress Tests for Lock Recovery
stories.description: Create targeted tests simulating worker crashes, missed heartbeats, and concurrent acquisition races to validate TTL handling and deadlock recovery under realistic failure conditions.
